Illustrations, line drawings and doodles are generated by `pipeline/10_stylize.py` from the same 600 px crop as the
photo, so each object keeps its position and size; each style also gets a cut-out inside the photo's mask.
Generation settings per word are in `stimuli/stylize_params.csv`.

```{python}
#| include: false
import sys, os, warnings; warnings.filterwarnings('ignore'); sys.path.insert(0, '../pipeline')
import pandas as pd
from config import STIM, OUT, FIG
```

## Contact sheet

One row per pair as shown on a trial, word A's formats then word B's (`pipeline/13_format_sheet.py`).

![](../docs/figures/format_sheet.png)

## Generation settings

```{python}
sp = pd.read_csv(f'{STIM}/stylize_params.csv')
print(sp.groupby('style').size().to_string())
print(sp[sp.label != sp.word].to_string(index=False))
```

Words whose prompt label differs from the bare word: "balloon" alone drifts to a hot-air balloon, and lizard/frog
drift to green.

## Does the stylized object keep the photo's silhouette?

`pipeline/11_silhouette_check.py`: segment the stylized image with the same Grounding DINO + SAM recipe as the photo and
compare with the photo's mask. The cut-out version always uses the photo's mask, so a low IoU means the illustration's
object is a different shape and its cut-out clips it (or shows background inside the mask).

```{python}
f = f'{OUT}/silhouette_check.csv'
if os.path.exists(f):
    s = pd.read_csv(f)
    print(s.groupby('style')[['iou', 'area_ratio']].describe().round(2).T.to_string(), '\n')
    print(s.sort_values('iou').head(8).to_string(index=False))
else:
    print('not run yet')
```

## Known flaws under repair

From review of the first-round illustrations. Redo candidates (`10_stylize.py --candidates`, ControlNet scale 0.9,
seeds 2–4, corrected labels) replace a word once a candidate is picked; the replaced image moves to
`stimuli/images/history/round{k}/`.

| Word | Problem | Fix being tried |
| --- | --- | --- |
| snail | two pairs of eye stalks | label "garden snail with a single pair of eye stalks" |
| turkey | two heads (the turkey_04s photo shows two birds) | swap the exemplar to turkey_11s, regenerate |
| acorn | green cap | label "brown acorn with a brown scaly cap" |
| camel | hind legs muddled | label "camel standing on four legs" |
| squirrel | white blob at the paws | label "grey squirrel sitting" |
| crow | grey band across the bottom | label "black crow standing on grass" |
| cloud | rain streaks | label "single white cloud in a clear blue sky" |
| cow | pink | label "black and white holstein cow" |
| snake | yellow / teal | label "brown and black patterned snake" |
| rabbit | grass inside the cut-out | label "brown wild rabbit" |
| hamster, monkey | fatter than the photo (IoU .66 / .60; area ×1.37 / ×1.66) | stronger ControlNet (0.9); monkey "monkey sitting" |

Hamster and monkey are fatter because img2img at strength 1.0 with ControlNet at 0.7 lets SDXL drift toward its prior
body shape; the photo mask then trims the illustration's cut-out.
